decisions.reason: Replacing INA219 with INA3221 does not change the standalone LDO, source-selection, or shared-rail supply requirements.
The monitoring-IC replacement does not change the 5V rail converter, loads, enable GPIO, or shutdown behavior.
The sensor modules and their 3.3V interface remain unchanged by the current-monitor replacement.
Changing the downstream current-monitor IC does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power path.
The prior INA219 reference is descriptive of downstream monitoring; the board-chain topology, connectors, and power distribution remain valid unchanged.
The LED 5V supply and data-level-shifter requirements are unaffected by which IC monitors the power rails.
The current-monitor replacement does not determine or change the battery connector's series, mounting, or pinout.
The eight-LED board's role, LED count, and LED family remain unchanged.
The BOOT and reset controls and their capacitance values are independent of the rail-monitoring IC.
Replacing INA219 with INA3221 does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module.
The USB-C programming interface remains unchanged by the power-rail monitor selection.
The LED power-cutoff behavior, GPIO5 control, and zero-standby target do not depend on the selected current-monitor IC.
